questions.prompt: A family of quadratic functions is given by $f(x)=a(x-3)(x+2)$, where $a \neq 0$. What property is shared by every function in the family?
questions.explanation: Factored form shows the zeros. Every function has $x$-intercepts $3$ and $-2$.
$330^\circ$ has reference angle $30^\circ$ and is in quadrant IV, where sine is negative. So $\sin 330^\circ=-1/2$.
